questions.question: The SI unit of pressure is:
questions.explanation: The SI unit of pressure is Pascal (Pa), where 1 Pa = 1 N/m².

questions.question: One Pascal is equivalent to:
questions.explanation: Pressure = Force / Area → 1 Pa = 1 N/m².

questions.question: The upward force exerted by a fluid on an object immersed in it is called:
questions.explanation: Buoyancy (upthrust) is the upward force due to pressure difference in a fluid.

questions.question: According to Archimedes’ Principle, upthrust is equal to:
questions.explanation: Archimedes’ Principle: Upthrust = weight of displaced fluid.
